content.title: Blog: Pant steers LSG home
content.text: LSG won by 5 wickets (with 1 ball remaining)LiveUpdated: Apr 5, 2026, 8:41 AM•Published Apr 5, 2026, 1:55 AMBy Hemant BrarApr 5, 2026, 8:41 AMPant stands tall for LSGUnadkat starts the over with a full ball; Pant drills it down the ground for four.Unadkat then goes slow and into the pitch; Pant swats it over mid-off for another four, levelling the scores.Unadkat brings the field in and bowls two dots before Pant launches the fifth ball over mid-off to take his team home.LSG have their first win of the season; SRH now have two losses and one win from three.Apr 5, 2026, 8:35 AMNine needed from last overHarshal Patel bowls an excellent over, conceding only four. It seemed he had trapped Choudhary lbw with a dipping full toss. The on-field umpire gave it out but on review, it emerged that the impact was outside off stump.Now, nine are needed from six balls. Unadkat has the ball. The bigger boundary is on Pant's leg side.Apr 5, 2026, 8:31 AMFifty for PantBut there's hardly any celebration. Because in the same over, Dubey had Samad caught at long-off. Mukul Choudhary is the last recognised batter. He takes a single off the first ball to give Pant the strike. Pant drills Dubey down the ground to find a crucial boundary and reduce the equation to 13 required from 12 balls. The boundary brings up Pant's fifty off 43 balls.Apr 5, 2026, 8:21 AMPant, Samad steer LSG's chaseA six-run 15th over by Malinga makes it 43 required from five overs but Pant releases the pressure with a couple of fours off Unadkat. Samad does the same against Malinga in the following over.LSG need 19 from 3Apr 5, 2026, 8:03 AMDubey, Shivang keep SRH in the conestBadoni skips down the track to Dubey but the bowler bowls it full, fast and wide outside off. Badoni fails to make any contact with it and is stumped by a mile.Nicholas Pooran walks in at No. 5 but lasts only four balls. He sweeps Shivang fine and instinctively sets off for a run, without realising Kishan has fielded the ball. Pooran is run out. Abdul Samad is the new batter. Pant is still there, batting on 32 off 30.LSG are still the favourites with 49 needed from six overs but it's no longer a walk in the park.LSG 108/4 after 14Apr 5, 2026, 7:55 AMA different Shami this season?Apr 5, 2026, 7:50 AMShivang gets Markram but LSG aheadPant is living dangerously. He tries to go aerial against Malinga but barely clears mid-off. On the next ball, he goes areial towards deep square leg, where Shivang Kumar runs to his right, dives sideways and goes one-handed but the ball doesn't stick.But Shivang makes up for it by dismissing Markram. It was a wrong'un and Markram holed out to long-off. Impact Player Badoni joins Pant in the middle.LSG 81/2 after 10Apr 5, 2026, 7:34 AMMarkram steers LSG's chaseIn the last over of the powerplay, Markram struck Unadkat for two fours and a six. He has reached 45 off 26 balls and even with Pant struggling for timing - he is on 7 off ten - LSG are in a comfortable position.LSG 67/1 after 8Apr 5, 2026, 7:29 AMPant and Kishan's contrasting fortunesApr 5, 2026, 7:17 AMMalinga gets Marsh, Pant in at No. 3Eshan Malinga, coming in as Impact Player for Travis Head, strikes in his first over, the fifth of the innings. It was a short-of-good-length ball at Marsh. The batter went for the pull but holed out to deep square leg.Pant walks in at No. 3.LSG 38/1 after 5Apr 5, 2026, 7:11 AMLSG's steady startIt has been a steady start for LSG. After a two-run first over, Markram and Marsh picked up three fours off Ready in the second. Unadkat goes pace-off into the pitch but Markram delays his shot and pulls him over wide long-on for a six.LSG 33/0 after 4Apr 5, 2026, 7:04 AMMarsh and Markram open for LSG"We will see." That is what Rishabh Pant had said at the toss when he was asked if he would continue to open. And we see it's Marsh and Markram who have come out to kick things off for LSG. While I feel it's the right call but it's a bit of a surprise that the team management shelved the experiment after just one game, and it wasn't like the experiment failed big time. In fact, Pant was run out backing up at the non-striker's end.Two right-hand batters in the middle means left-arm spinner Harsh Dubey opens the bowling for SRH. He bowls with a slip and gives away only two singles in the over.LSG 2/0 after 1Apr 5, 2026, 6:46 AMSRH finish on 156 for 9A great comeback from LSG in the death overs. Despite ten runs from the final over, bowled by Prince Yadav, they gave away only 33 in the last four and picked up five wickets. ESPNcricinfo's Forecaster is giving LSG a 73.21% chance of winning.Avesh says the ball was reverse-swinging at the death, which helped them.Apr 5, 2026, 6:34 AMReddy, Klaasen fall in quick successionFor a moment, it looked like SRH could easily get 175. But LSG have sucked the momentum out of their innings. Siddharth had Reddy caught at deep cover in the 18th over. In the next, Avesh removed Klaasen, who tried a reverse paddle but ended up hitting it too fine, with Pant taking a diving catch. On the following delivery, he had Harsh Dubey chopping on after the batter had walked at the bowler.Avesh gives away only two runs in that over.SRH 146/7 after 19Apr 5, 2026, 6:28 AMFifty for Reddy tooAnd he gets there in just 30 balls. Brings out the "flower nahin, fire hai main" [I am not a flower, I am fire] from the movie Pushpa.SRH 134/4 after 17Apr 5, 2026, 6:21 AMFifty for KlaasenAfter coming in at 11 for 3, Klaasen brings up his fifty off 33 balls.Apr 5, 2026, 6:19 AMSRH on the chargeThis is the SRH the Orange Army came out to see. Reddy takes apart Rathi with three sixes in the 15th over. Klaasen begins the 16th by Prince with a six.The last 30 balls have produced 79 runs, seven fours and five sixes. The partnership is 94, the highest fifth-wicket stand for SRH in the IPL. The previous record was set in the previous match by these two very batters.Apr 5, 2026, 6:05 AMKlaasen, Reddy open upReddy starts the 11th over bowled by Prince Yadav with a six. Klaasen also picks up a six later in the over. In the next, Reddy takes down Rathi with back-to-back fours.Mukul Choudhary drops Klaasen off Siddharth with the batter on 19, and Klaasen makes them pay in the following over. He hits Avesh for four fours in a 17-run over. Before that over, Klaasen was on 21 off 21. By the end of it, he had moved to 40 off 27.SRH 94/4 after 14Apr 5, 2026, 5:51 AMLowest ten-over totals in IPL35 SRH are 35 for 4 after ten overs, the fourth-lowest IPL total at the halfway markThe lowest three are KKR's 31 for 3 against Deccan Chargers (remember them?) in 2009, RR's 32 for 5 against RCB in 2009 and MI's 32 for 4 against Kings XI Punjab in 2015.Apr 5, 2026, 5:40 AMRathi puts SRH in further troubleRathi is back and strikes first ball. Livingstone tries a lap shot but ends up deflecting it onto his shoulder. The ball lobs up. Pant, who was going leg side, changes his direction and dives to pouch it with his right glove.Just like the previous game, Nitish Kumar Reddy and Klaasen will have to revive the innings. But unlike the last time, they don't have the cushion of a quick start.Shami returns for the ninth over and, bowling a mix off pace-on and pace-off deliveries, he gives away only three singles. That means he ends his four overs with 2 for 9.Apr 5, 2026, 5:30 AMA powerless powerplayAfter a third over for Shami in the first six, M Siddharth bowls the final over of the powerplay. He concedes only a single off the first four balls before Livingstone uses his feet to hit him over long-on for the first six of the innings. Still, SRH have reached only 22 for 3 after six overs.Apr 5, 2026, 5:21 AMKishan departs, SRH in disarrayAfter just one over, Rathi has been taken off. Prince Yadav, who was excellent against Delhi Capitals in LSG's previous game, replaces him. And he continues his good form. Swinging the ball into Ishan Kishan, he beats his inside edge and uproots his off stump.That leaves SRH on 11 for 3 and Livingstone and Heinrich Klaasen with a big job on their hands.Apr 5, 2026, 5:16 AMShami strikes again, sends Head backShami has dealt another blow to his former side, with another slower one. This one, bowled at 121.6kph, on a good length around off stump. Head looks to hit it on the up but the lack of pace means he ends up hitting it in the air towards mid-off. Markram is alert there - after a couple of steps, he dives forward to catch it.Liam Livingstone leaves alone the hat-trick ball.Another quiet over, SRH are 10 for 2 after three.Apr 5, 2026, 5:12 AMRathi shares new ballOn the surface, a legspinner against two left-hand batters inside the powerplay doesn't sound like a great idea. But Rathi bowls all sorts of deliveries. Just like his idol Sunil Narine, or Varun Chakravarthy. He starts with a short ball that Head pulls for four. But he concedes only three off the remaining five balls.Apr 5, 2026, 5:08 AMShami gets Abhishek in first overMohammed Shami, playing against his former team, strikes in the first over of the innings. He gets the ball to swing back in straightaway to Travis Head, and then with the last ball of the over, he has Abhishek Sharma caught at short third. It was an offcutter from Shami, at 114.7kph. Abhishek tries to go after it but he only gets a thick outside edge to short third, where M Siddharth throws to his right to take it with both hands.SRH 1/1 after 1Apr 5, 2026, 4:53 AMWill Pant bat at No. 3?Apr 5, 2026, 4:31 AMLSG opt to bowl, SRH bring in Livingstone and HarshalToss Lucknow Super Giants chose to bowl vs Sunrisers HyderabadLucknow Super Giants (LSG) captain Rishabh Pant won the toss and opted to bowl against Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) under overcast skies in Hyderabad. His reason to do so, though, left many confused.“It looks like a good wicket for sure but at the same time, there is something for the bowlers as well,” Pant said. “After the powerplay it will be harder to score.”When asked if he would continue opening the innings, Pant said: “We’ll see.” In the teamsheet, he was slotted in at No. 3.LSG also brought in M Siddharth and Avesh Khan. Anrich Nortje and Mohsin Khan made way for them. Digvesh Rathi, who sat out the last game as LSG used Shahbaz Ahmed as an emergency Impact Player, was also part of the bowl-first XI.SRH also made a couple of changes, bringing in Liam Livingstone and Harshal Patel. Salil Arora was left out, and only one of Eshan Malinga and David Payne can come in - both are part of the Impact Player bench.The match is being played on pitch no. 2. The last time an afternoon game was played on this pitch, in IPL 2025, SRH pumped 286 and Rajasthan Royals responded with 242.The square boundaries are 63 and 68 metres. The straight boundary is 75 metres.Sunrisers Hyderabad: 1 Abhishek Sharma, 2 Travis Head, 3 Ishan Kishan (capt, wk), 4 Heinrich Klaasen, 5 Liam Livingstone, 6 Aniket Verma, 7 Nitish Kumar Reddy, 8 Harsh Dubey, 9 Shivang Kumar, 10 Harshal Patel, 11 Jaydev Unadkat Impact Player options: Eshan Malinga, David Payne, Salil Arora, Shivam Mavi, Zeeshan AnsariLucknow Super Giants: 1 Mitchell Marsh, 2 Aiden Markram, 3 Rishabh Pant (capt, wk), 4 Nicholas Pooran, 5 Abdul Samad, 6 Mukul Choudhary, 7 Avesh Khan, 8 Mohammed Shami, 9 Prince Yadav, 10 Digvesh Rathi, 11 M Siddharth Impact Player options: Anrich Nortje, Himmat Singh, Shahbaz Ahmed, Ayush Badoni, Matthew BreetzkeApr 5, 2026, 4:10 AMWin the toss and......bat first, says Michael Clarke in his pitch report. Something that hasn't happened this season so far. Will it happen today?The square boundaries are 63 and 68 metres. The straight boundary is 75 metres.Apr 5, 2026, 3:46 AMRewindThe last time an afternoon game was played on pitch no. 2, the one which will be used today, SRH made 286 against RR. In total, 528 runs were scored that day. Kishan smashed a hundred in his first game for the franchise, and a bowler who conceded under 12 an over was under par.Apr 5, 2026, 3:35 AMScenes from the groundA few clouds around but it's a bright afternoon in Hyderabad. The warm-ups are under way. The seats are orange and the crowd are filling in slowly. The pitch is expected to be high-scoring but there may be some assistance for spin.Apr 5, 2026, 3:17 AM'We have a good record defending'What the teams are thinking..."It is a traditionally high-scoring track and we have a good record defending. But we enjoy chasing as well. As a group, you want to be equally confident no matter the situation. We are the first team this season to defend the score. It's important for us to do both things well and our batting group has the ability to adapt."Sunrisers Hyderabad head coach Daniel Vettori"T20 is always batter friendly. Batters are expected to play big shots and that's what the crowd comes for. But personally, I find bowlers have an opportunity to come good and become heroes. A bowler has to trust his abilities in order to do well.Lucknow Super Giants bowling coach Bharat ArunApr 5, 2026, 3:02 AMIn the spotlight - Nicholas Pooran and Shivang KumarNicholas Pooran has not crossed 17 in seven of his last eight T20s with form eluding him in the SA20 in January and no cricket in February and March. He has scored only 121 runs across 99 balls in T20s this calendar year and is averaging 15. He has also hit only nine sixes in his last eight T20s. He started IPL 2026 with a sluggish eight-ball 8. Can a batting-friendly Hyderabad surface just be what he needs to turn his fortunes around?As a left-arm wristspinner, Shivang Kumar is a rarity in the IPL and could be a point of difference in the SRH XI. In the Vijay Hazare Trophy, he took a five-wicket haul against Karnataka and scored a half-century against Jharkhand. In Kolkata, he conceded only two runs more than Sunil Narine and had much better figures than Varun Chakravarthy. A good enough show to give him a run in the afternoon game in Hyderabad?Apr 5, 2026, 2:39 AMCummins back home for scanPat Cummins is in Australia for a fitness test and will continue to be unavailable for SRH. If Brydon Carse - who had a bruised hand for the first two SRH games - is fit, then he could replace David Payne in the XI. SRH will also need to decide between seamer Harshal Patel and left-arm wristspinner Shivang Kumar.Sunrisers Hyderabad (probable) 1 Abhishek Sharma, 2 Travis Head, 3 Ishan Kishan (capt, wk), 4 Heinrich Klaasen, 5 Aniket Verma, 6 Nitish Kumar Reddy, 7 Salil Arora, 8 Harsh Dubey, 9 Shivang Kumar/Harshal Patel, 10 Jaydev Unadkat, 11 Eshan Malinga, 12 David Payne/Brydon Carse.On match eve, LSG bowling coach Bharat Arun said Digvesh Rathi will play in Hyderabad after missing the first game. There are no fitness concerns just yet.Lucknow Super Giants (probable) 1 Mitchell Marsh, 2 Rishabh Pant (capt, wk), 3 Aiden Markram, 4 Nicholas Pooran, 5 Ayush Badoni, 6 Abdul Samad, 7 Mukul Choudhary, 8 Mohammad Shami, 9 Anrich Nortje, 10 Prince Yadav, 11 Mohsin Khan, 12 Digvesh RathiApr 5, 2026, 2:13 AMHave your sayWhere should Rishabh Pant bat?4.1K votesApr 5, 2026, 1:54 AMQuestions aplenty for Pant and LSGBig picture - a tale of two captainsIt's been almost exactly ten years since the day Rishabh Pant and Ishan Kishan opened the batting together for India at the Under-19 World Cup final in Dhaka. In the decade that followed, one prodigious talent made his mark for his outrageous shots and chutzpah in Tests away from home, while the other did so with his blistering strike rate in white-ball cricket.While both have been hard to ignore, the attention on Pant was always greater than Kishan. Over the last 18 months, though, that story has flipped. Pant, a T20 World Cup winner himself in 2024, has since slipped out of India's T20I plans, while Kishan has pushed his way firmly back into contention with strong form in domestic cricket and then in his second run with the India T20I side. As it stands, Pant is still searching for his best batting position in the format, while Kishan, also a T20 World Cup winner, is among the most destructive No. 3s and far more assured of his game.If their journeys have diverged, so have the teams they now lead. Lucknow Super Giants began their season with a defeat at the hands of Punjab Kings after being all out for 141 while Sunrisers Hyderabad, after a loss to Royal Challengers Bengaluru, responded with a win in Kolkata that blended attacking batting with a bowling unit willing to adapt on the fly.Ten years on from Dhaka, the paths of two once-prodigies cross again, this time as captains. An afternoon start in Hyderabad is unlikely to offer much respite for bowlers and will bring into focus how the wicketkeeping batters lead their sides.SRHLSG100%50%100%SRH InningsLSG InningsOver 20 • LSG 160/5LSG won by 5 wickets (with 1 ball remaining)Instant answers to T20 questions
